# `csharp_blank_lines_after_control_transfer_statements`

Blank lines below one of those statements.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `0`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

*This option accepts a freeform value. No canned example is generated.*

```ini
csharp_blank_lines_after_control_transfer_statements = <value>
```
